response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile software engineer with strong web/full-stack and systems programming background, but the role demands deep, current C++ expertise in industrial automation with IEC 62443 secure development practices. His only professional C++ experience was a brief stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015; his recent decade has centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang for web platforms. There is no evidence of MQTT, industrial protocols, message-broker architectures at industrial scale, or SDL/IEC 62443 experience, making him a poor match despite his seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems
Low-latency, high-performance systems work at Dunnhumby (async I/O, fibers, millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~6 months, over a decade ago)
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus), or IEC 62443 security background
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack and AI tooling, diverging from the role's domain
